result:
I changed one line in `web/src/js/flow/utils.ts`, but I'm not sure it is the bug you meant. I didn't run tests or the app, and I didn't add a test.

The web UI never reads the `view_order_reversed` option. It only exists in `_options_gen.ts`, so reversal in the web UI comes from the `#` column's descending sort. The `index` sort function returned a constant `0`, so every flow compared as equal. When a live flow arrived under a descending `#` sort, `findInsertPos` in `ducks/flows/_utils.ts` treated it as a tie and appended it at the end. That is the wrong end for a reversed view.

`sortFunctions.index` now returns `flow.timestamp_created`. Creation time follows arrival order, so ascending gives the original order and descending puts new flows at the top. The same comparator is used for the initial sort and for updates, so those stay consistent.

Ties on other columns (for example method) under descending sort will still append at the end. Say if you want those changed too.

If you meant the `view_order_reversed` server option itself, that would need separate wiring into the flows reducer, which I haven't done.
